newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen down ahead of opposition strike.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen down ahead of opposition strike.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stocks Exchange (DSE) are likely to maintain a downtrend ahead of an expected nationwide strike on Sunday, brokers said.

"We were expecting that the market would start recovering from today. But it is now almost unlikely due to the strike," said broker Shakil Rizvi. The opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has called a strike for Sunday in its first major move to destabilise the government of Sheikh Hasina.
The DSE all-share price index closed 6.42 points or 0.5 percent down at 1,273.85 on turnover of 79.1 million taka on Thursday.
